title: Routes to diversification in Africa (EDAR 2023 background)
summary: Four background papers on critical minerals for UNCTAD’s Economic Development in Africa Report 2023.
description: Four background papers for UNCTAD's Economic Development in Africa Report 2023 on critical minerals and routes to diversification: linkages and medium-high-tech supply chains, and case studies of renewable energy technologies in Morocco, batteries and mining equipment in South Africa, and mobile phone technologies in the DRC.
